title: self_check_request (frozen T00, YZT-46)
description: Native API input for self_check: can the already-started target role use an existing Role Context Package as-is? Default path performs no full rebuild. Framework-neutral; the caller supplies the same normalized task snapshot it would send to prepare_handoff.

package_ref.description: Optional pointer to the candidate package (e.g. its package_id or its storage locator). Omitted when the caller wants the latest valid package for task_ref + role resolved by the memory system.
